/-- Helper: For any n ≥ 7, n! ≥ 3^n -/

lemma fact_ge_3pow_at_least_7 : ∀ n, 7 ≤ n → Nat.factorial n ≥ 3 ^ n := by
  intro n hn
  have step : ∀ k, 7 ≤ k → Nat.factorial k ≥ 3 ^ k → Nat.factorial (k + 1) ≥ 3 ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk hk_fact
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
    have h : 3 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
    calc
      Nat.factorial (k + 1) = (k + 1) * Nat.factorial k := by simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
      _ ≥ (k + 1) * 3 ^ k := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        exact hk_fact
      _ ≥ 3 * 3 ^ k := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
        exact h
      _ = 3 ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  induction' hn with n hn IH
  · norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  · exact step n hn IH
